name: simfiles
algorithm: the simulated namespace's lookups: one std.sim Sim, n files created, each statted and renamed, and each new name statted (README.md).

skip.go: no std simulated Io (testing/fstest.MapFS is a read-only file tree with no crash model)

notes: Written by std-sim for SIM-R21 (status/std-sim.md): FindNode scans the node table, so this row is quadratic in n until the planned path index lands; it is here to measure that, not to publish a ratio.
